text:
Tara: Quick sync — release week plan for SDK v1.5, quickstarts, and sample apps. Key dates: changelog cutoff Fri 03/20 EOD, docs freeze Mon 03/23, canary deploy Tue 03/24. Who's owning final sample app smoke and changelog? :eyes:
Micah: I can own sample apps smoke. Will run smokepack and CI checks. Expect ~3hrs to finish QA. @Devon I'll ping you if we need feature flags toggled.
Devon: Confirmed — I can flip flags for canary. Changelog cutoff OK for me but need PRs in by Thu EOD. I'll do the release notes skeleton.
Nina: Docs team: we need final API surface callouts by Wed 03/18 (so we can ship examples). Any breaking param changes?
Kia: There's a tiny param rename in auth helper (`client_key` -> `api_key`). It'll be backward-compatible for one release via alias, but we should call it out in changelog and quickstarts.
Sam: CI: one flaky test still failing in sampleapp-integration. Logs:
```
FAIL sample-integration/test_auth.py::test_token_rotation
AssertionError: expected 200 != 401
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/sample-integration/test_auth.py", line 48, in test_token_rotation
```
Micah: Thanks Sam — I'll rerun with `--rerun-failed` and check test harness. ETA 2hrs.
Tara: Can we get a list of owner -> deliverable? My proposed map:
- Micah: sample apps smoke + sample CI fixes
- Devon: changelog + release notes skeleton
- Nina: docs examples + API callouts
- Kia: code PR for param alias + migration note
- Sam: CI stabilization + flaky test root cause
Reply with ✅ to confirm or update owners.
Micah: ✅
Devon: ✅
Nina: ✅ — will add doc PR by Wed
Kia: ✅ — PR tomorrow AM
Sam: ✅ — investigating flaky now
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for `devex/sdk-v1.5` on 1748520000. Canary cohort: internal + 5% production traffic. Notifications to #incidents and #product.
Tara: Great. Next: changelog process — Devon, can you add the migration note and callout for `client_key` alias? Also please tag `@release-manager` in the final PR.
Devon: Will do. One ask: can docs include the minimal quickstart snippet referencing `api_key` so customers see both keys? Nina: Yep, will include both variants.
Tara: OK team — let's re-sync if anything slips. If you hit blocker ping here and add a short status update (blocked/in-progress/done). Thanks :raised_hands:
